description: This cotton blend bib apron helps to keep employees hands dry and their uniforms or clothes stain free. While often overlooked, aprons are an essential tool in many restaurants because they help protect employees from injuries and accidents as well as help to maintain the appearance of a clean, well run kitchen. 65-Percent polyester and 35-percent cotton twill 3-pockets apron with extra long waist ties. Available in burgundy color and that is dark enough to hide stains exceptionally well. Measures 33-inch length by 28-1/2-inch width.
